QuestInfo.name: [Solatum] A Message Passed Under Shade
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart wants to meet regarding a secret message from #bPrince Carlisle#k. Meet with him at the Operations Center in Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: Meet Neinheart at #bOperations Center#k to hear Carlisle's message.
QuestInfo.2: The #bOrder of Thenia#k was exiled from Cernium and made their new home in the #bSolatum Valley#k. The Order called for help, knowing that the awakening gods were beginning to disappear...
